Hakkari Shadowcaster

This NPC can be found in Zul'Gurub (5).

Gains

After killing this NPC you will gain:
  • Normal
    • 3 reputation with Zandalar Tribe (stops at Revered)
  • Heroic
    • 3 reputation with Zandalar Tribe (stops at Revered)
  • Mythic
    • 3 reputation with Zandalar Tribe (stops at Revered)
  • Ascended
    • 3 reputation with Zandalar Tribe (stops at Revered)
